history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1818 in County Kerry, Ireland and came to Chicago about 1868. He works as a blacksmith, and the household lives on the West Side by the river, near Canal Street. The family's church is Holy Family.
